item.title: Assignment operator -> shortcut in RStudio
item.description: I write a lot of tidy code interactively and it's so natural to me to use the -> assignment operator at the end of the pipe. Indeed, I'd love to have a shortcut for it in Rstudio. Anyone else in the same situation?
